evidence_items.evidence_summary: The filing describes server and open-compute platform development, including standards and architectures supporting heterogeneous processors.
The annual report identifies high-end computers, general servers, storage, data-center products and intelligent-computing infrastructure as core businesses.
The filing describes a portfolio of 100G through 800G and higher-speed optical modules serving cloud data-center customers.
The annual report links Ethernet optical-module demand to AI compute clusters and cloud data centers and discusses the high-speed product market.
The filing separately discloses revenue from high-speed switching and routing, AI server and HPC, and general server application areas.
The annual report states that AI-server and related product demand accelerated and became a key driver of PCB orders.
The filing identifies optical devices, modules and subsystems for telecommunications and data-center networks as the principal business.
The filing describes switching, network operation and high-density networking solutions and the use of elastic compute and intelligent scheduling in cloud products.
